title: Canonical Hook Input
description: Normalized JSON that adapters produce on stdin for hook scripts.

client.description: Identifier of the calling agentic client.

event.description: Canonical event name. 'before_shell_execution' covers shell/command execution. 'before_file_read' covers non-shell file tools (e.g. Read, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit on Claude Code).

type.description: Action category as defined by the IDE's hook system. 'command' is shell execution. 'file_read' is a non-shell file-tool action (open/edit/inspect a file path) that pairs with the 'before_file_read' event.

workspace_roots.description: Absolute paths to workspace root directories. Empty array if the IDE does not provide workspace info.

cwd.description: Current working directory of the action. Falls back to the first workspace_roots entry if the IDE payload omits it. Empty string only when truly unavailable.

command.description: Shell command string about to be executed. Empty string for non-shell events (e.g. 'before_file_read').

tool_name.description: IDE tool identifier from the payload (e.g. 'Bash', 'run_in_terminal', 'Read'). Empty string when not applicable.

file_path.description: Absolute (or IDE-provided) path to the file being read/edited/inspected, for non-shell file-tool events (e.g. Read, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit on Claude Code). Empty string for shell-command events or when not applicable.

raw_payload.description: The original, unmodified JSON payload from the IDE, preserved verbatim.
